new_intake.reader: global agent; root read closing status
findings: Full-mask individual absolute moment obstruction for every fixed real q>1, leaving joint-frequency products open.

new_intake.head: 7af83b786636abba2f44fe8c81441153331377fc
new_intake.reader: cycle agent; root read convex counterconstruction
findings: Excludes primitive ordinary cycles with canonical width W<2, minimum at least 2^71, and odd period at most 10^1000. Published finite trajectory verification supplies the minimum input for nontrivial cycles.
959 candidate upper convergents are excluded by exact finite inequalities; finite Lean arithmetic is distinct from the written real-logarithm, continued-fraction and Collatz reductions.
Proper rational cycles with one occupied fractional part are singletons; general residue diversity does not exclude denominator-one ordinary cycles.
Abstract convex subcubic labels satisfy binary ternary-tree restrictions and the lowbit hypotheses of our local Hankel-rank theorem, but not the actual chronological affine recurrence.
No effective overlap between finite period exclusion and asymptotic finiteness is supplied.

new_intake.head: 6795369ac4e604eec342c0b6c08b9a14cd2ca4ec
new_intake.reader: escape agent; root read final synthesis
findings: Critical first-clearance census has actual ordinary endpoint weights proportional to (1+log y)*y^(-log_3(2)) with stated clock and residue hypotheses.
Permanent critical survival equals a weighted escaping-source quantity up to stated comparisons, and excludes cycle contributions; its extinction is unproved.
Canonical augmented return and outward paths give explicit source/clock bounds while retaining an unproved ordinary basin implication.
Final synthesis reports the full physical source exponent 37/100 and conditional microscopic joining entropy, with their external inputs and weak-limit scope.
No upper bound for our stopped-row or finite-energy criterion follows from these new source laws.
